tasks.short: Plan and administer prevention and treatment health programs

steps.what: Review actual population needs, program outcomes, clinical evidence and service constraints for the prevention/treatment program
inputs: actual existing aggregate service/health-needs evidence
actual current program scope and clinical guidance
outputs: physician-checked program needs and evidence limits

steps.what: Plan actual health-program objectives, prevention/treatment activities, responsibilities and evaluation criteria
inputs: physician-checked program needs and evidence limits
actual service capacity and delegated program responsibilities
outputs: physician's program plan and clinical/operational rationale

steps.what: Write and check the actual program plan with evidence references and unresolved implementation conditions
inputs: physician's program plan and clinical/operational rationale
outputs: complete checked health-program plan within existing authority

steps.what: Save the completed checked health-program plan in the existing program workspace
inputs: complete checked health-program plan within existing authority

steps.what: Administer the actual established health program through coordination with responsible service staff and resolution of implementation issues
inputs: saved health-program plan
actual existing organisational authorisation and staff responsibilities
outputs: actual program coordination and resolved/unresolved delivery issues

steps.what: Implement actual physician-owned prevention or treatment program activities and assess delivery problems
inputs: actual program coordination and resolved/unresolved delivery issues
actual authorised service activities and participants
outputs: actual physician program delivery and observed implementation limits

tasks.design: Configure existing aggregate program evidence views in {OTHER}, the clinical/service reporting application, and fixed source-reference fields in {DOCS}. The physician plans, documents and checks the program, then retains actual coordination and implementation within existing organisational authorisation; no clinical program decisions are generated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated evidence navigation and exact reference entry can interrupt program planning.
tasks.enabler_now: Native aggregate views and document fields can reuse actual current evidence.
tasks.still_hard: Appropriate prevention/treatment and workable delivery depend on actual population and service context.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when a sensible program plan cannot be safely delivered with existing resources.

ambition.what: No automatic program launch or health-outcome improvement claim.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-7 for permitted aggregate health data and program-owner consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native aggregate evidence views can reduce navigation while health-program planning and clinical implementation remain physician-led.

assumptions: Shares describe provisional physician effort in an existing authorised program planning/delivery cycle, not a measured health-service baseline.
Service data owners provide actual existing aggregates and program records; the physician checks gaps in s1. No new surveillance feed or participant data capture is assumed free.
Only evidence navigation and fixed references change. Existing equivalent tools remove the gain; all substantive plan writing, coordination and actual delivery remain counted.
Gross provisional saving 2.7 minus 0.75 hour of evidence/reference upkeep gives 1.95 net. Save is negligible and fully retained.

Saving the plan does not approve a new service or patient treatment. Existing organisational and individual clinical authorisations remain required before actual implementation; no extra notice or automated order is promised.
unknowns: Actual program responsibilities and aggregate evidence access
research_questions: Does native evidence linking remove repeated physician handling in actual program planning?

already_counted.description: Review evidence and complete/check program plan

incremental.description: Maintain aggregate evidence and plan reference links

approvals.approved_version: complete checked health-program plan within existing authority

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 1.95%; clinical planning and actual implementation remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare required birth, death, disease and medical-status reports

steps.what: Read the actual government/organisation report requirements, permitted population and reporting period
inputs: actual required birth/death/disease report form and definitions
actual authorised reporting population and recipient
outputs: physician-checked reporting definitions and disclosure scope

steps.what: Collect and check actual birth, death or disease source records for the defined report
inputs: physician-checked reporting definitions and disclosure scope
actual authorised clinical event records
outputs: physician-checked report source events with provenance and gaps

steps.what: Compile the actual required statistical report fields and totals from checked clinical source events
inputs: physician-checked report source events with provenance and gaps
physician-checked reporting definitions and disclosure scope

steps.what: Complete and check final report counts, definitions, permitted disclosures and intended government recipient
inputs: draft required clinical statistical report
physician-checked report source events with provenance and gaps
outputs: complete checked authorised statistical report and government recipient

steps.what: Submit the completed checked authorised statistical report to the intended government recipient
inputs: complete checked authorised statistical report and government recipient
outputs: submitted required statistical report and receipt

tasks.design: Configure native event views and report fields in {OTHER}, the clinical reporting application, and {DOCS} for actual authorised statistical reporting. The physician resolves source gaps and checks all report definitions/disclosures before the separate {GOV_PORTAL} submission; no narrative clinical status or workforce evaluation is inferred.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated event navigation and report-field compilation can consume physician reporting effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native report configuration can reuse actual checked event records and fixed definitions.
tasks.still_hard: Misclassified events and disclosure scope can invalidate a technically correct total.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when a source code or reporting definition misrepresents the clinical event.

ambition.what: No automatic medical certification or disclosure decision.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-8 for clinical-event access, permitted disclosures and reporting-authority consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native clinical event reporting can reduce repeated compilation while event classification and permitted disclosure require authorised checks.

assumptions: Shares describe provisional physician work for an actual required birth/death/disease statistics report, one of the task's alternatives, not an invented reporting obligation.

Clinicians/registry staff produce actual event ID, event type/date, relevant classifications and patient/source identity within existing clinical records. Physician collection and manual gap/classification resolution remain in s2/s4.
Native report configuration first; existing equivalent reports remove the gain. Missing source fields stop for manual resolution rather than guessed statistics.
Gross provisional saving 10.5 minus 2 hours of report definition/source upkeep gives 8.5 net. Submission is negligible and fully retained.

The physician has actual reporting authority and checks the exact final report/recipient in s4; edits void the gate. Individual medical-status and workforce reports require their own real content and disclosure review, not automatic reuse of this estimate.
unknowns: Actual required reports, physician role and native export coverage
research_questions: Does native reporting save actual physician compilation after full event and disclosure checks?

already_counted.description: Collect/check source events, inspect report and verify final disclosure

incremental.description: Maintain event/report definitions and verify source mappings

approvals.approved_version: complete checked authorised statistical report and government recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 8.5%; source resolution, classification and disclosure checks remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Research medications, treatments and procedures for disease prevention or control

steps.what: Develop the actual research question and defensible study method for evaluating medications, treatments or procedures
inputs: actual clinical research question and permitted evidence
actual protocol constraints and study authorisations

steps.what: Conduct actual authorised retrospective research by reviewing permitted clinical records and verifying treatment/outcome evidence
inputs: physician's specified treatment/procedure research method
actual permitted clinical source records

steps.what: Enter and check actual research observations, coded case identities, treatment definitions and outcome fields
inputs: physician-reviewed actual treatment/outcome source evidence
actual protocol field definitions and permitted coded identities
outputs: complete checked actual research observation entries

steps.what: Save the completed checked actual research observation entries in the authorised research database
inputs: complete checked actual research observation entries

steps.what: Analyze actual treatment/procedure research observations and evaluate confounding, uncertainty and conclusions
inputs: saved authorised research observations
physician's specified treatment/procedure research method
outputs: physician's actual research analysis and treatment/procedure evidence limits

tasks.design: Configure native source views, fixed coded-case fields and repeatable analysis profiles in {OTHER}, the clinical/research database and statistical applications. The physician conducts the actual authorised record-based study, captures/checks observations before saving and retains causal/clinical interpretation; no treatment intervention or automatic research conclusion is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated source navigation, fixed identity entry and human analysis setup can interrupt retrospective research.
tasks.enabler_now: Native research configuration can reuse actual coded identities and selected analysis profiles.
tasks.still_hard: Confounding and incomplete outcome evidence may prevent a defensible treatment inference.
tasks.human_edge: Reject a plausible treatment association that does not support a causal conclusion.

ambition.what: No autonomous trial, treatment selection or new efficacy claim.

build_days.consent_and_access: 4-10 for actual study permissions, clinical/research data access and responsible research consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native research-source views and fixed record fields can reduce handling while clinical study design, evidence capture and causal interpretation remain physician work.

assumptions: Shares describe provisional human effort for an actual authorised retrospective treatment/procedure study, not all research or a clinical-trial baseline.

Clinical record owners supply actual treatment/outcome source records and authorised coded identities. The physician reads source evidence in s2 and manually captures/checks all research observations in s3; only fixed identifiers are reused.
No new structured clinical phenotype feed, automated outcome extraction or free consent process is assumed. Actual study authority exists before access; missing fields require manual investigation.
Only navigation, fixed identity entry and repeatable analysis setup change. Native calculation runtime already belongs to today and equivalent current configuration removes the gain.

Gross provisional saving 4.9 minus 1.5 hours of source/field/profile upkeep gives 3.4 net. Save is negligible and fully retained; experimental/interventional research needs its actual conduct and authorisation work measured separately.
unknowns: Actual study type, permitted records and existing native tools
research_questions: Does configuration reduce real retrospective research effort after source reading, observation capture and validity checks?

already_counted.description: Read source evidence, capture/check research observations and interpret analysis

incremental.description: Maintain research source links, coded fields and analysis profiles

approvals.approved_version: complete checked actual research observation entries

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 3.4%; actual scientific/clinical research judgment and observation capture remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

skills_to_grow: Validate program evidence and reporting definitions
role.ambitious_version: Reduce repeated program, reporting and research evidence handling while retaining physician clinical and scientific responsibility.
